_comment: Copy this file to athlete-private.json (gitignored) and fill in your real values. The shell merges this onto the public athlete-profile.json at boot. Any field can be omitted — the merge only overlays what you provide.

breathing._comment: Document any breathing conditions that affect training. Omit the section entirely if none apply.

mental_health._comment: Mental state is treated as physiology in this app. Set the flags that apply to you. Omit entirely if none.
